mentions.name: Pistepal
mentions.description: A ski map app offering turn-by-turn navigation on the mountain, built over the last few months and launched for the start of the ski season. It is priced at $10/month, undercutting the competition, with a free tier and a short daily trial.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://pistepal.app/ - a ski map app - built at breakneck speed over the last few months. I believe this is the only ski map app that offers turn-by-turn navigation!
